about: Jason Mallister at Seagard, a sworn house of Riverrun; eight hundred of his men stand at Seagard under Patrek. (hold-out: orders written apart from the pre-parser, and never tuned against)

items.text: Close Seagard's gates and let no one in.
Patrek should take a hundred riders to hunt the ironborn raiders along the coast.
Send five hundred dragons to Lord Walder as a wedding gift.
March our host to Riverrun and put it at Lord Tully's command.
